subject: planner: move PhysicalPointget related logic into physical op dir (#63168)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent: it relocates `PointGetPlan`/`BatchPointGetPlan` and related helpers into `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop` (notably `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/physical_batch_point_get.go` and `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/physical_utils.go`), then updates planner/executor call sites and plan-cache clone/rebuild paths accordingly. Spot-checked the moved logic (plan-cache `CloneForPlanCache`/`FastClonePointGetForPlanCache`, range rebuild, partition pruning entrypoints, unique-index key encoding) for semantic equivalence and found no plausible remaining Blocker/High correctness/consistency/txn/privilege regressions introduced by the refactor. Checked later `pingcap/master` history for PointGet-related follow-ups; subsequent commits appear to be refactors/perf/ancillary recognition rather than fixes for a correctness regression in this move.
